title: Claude Code launches five essential plugins for #claudecode #aicodingtools #softwaredevelopment
description: Claude Code and Codex introduced five essential plugins for vibe coding. These tools enhance AI capabilities by automating browser testing, simplifying database management, identifying security vulnerabilities, reverse-engineering design systems, and keeping libraries up to date. Playwright CLI enables automated browser interactions and error detection. Supabase streamlines database creation and management directly from the terminal. Strix secures apps by simulating hacker attacks to find weaknesses. SkillUI extracts design systems from any site for consistent front-end development. Context7 ensures coding assistants use the latest tools and dependencies, improving efficiency and code quality. Together, these plugins empower developers to build, test, secure, and maintain applications faster and with greater precision, driving innovation in AI-assisted coding workflows. #ClaudeCode #Codex #PlaywrightCLI #Supabase #StrixSecurity #SkillUI #Context7 #VibeCoding #AICodingTools #DevOps #AppSecurity #FrontendDevelopment #DatabaseManagement #CodingPlugins #AIWorkflow
